symptom: PC-A cannot ping PC-B on the same switch.
ai_root_cause: Ports Fa0/1 and Fa0/2 are assigned to VLAN 1 instead of VLAN 10.
reviewer_note: Correct diagnosis confirmed by show vlan brief output.

symptom: All PCs cannot obtain an IP address automatically.
ai_root_cause: DHCP pool is missing the default-router statement.
human_correction: DHCP pool missing both default-router and lease duration. Clients timed out after 1 day.
reviewer_note: AI missed the missing lease statement. Fix is incomplete without setting lease time.

ai_root_cause: R2 RIP config missing network 192.168.3.0 statement.
reviewer_note: AI correctly identified the asymmetric routing caused by missing network statement.

ai_root_cause: ACL OUTSIDE_IN deny rule blocks all traffic to DMZ server.
human_correction: The root issue is also that NAT is not configured for the DMZ server — ACL fix alone won't restore connectivity.
reviewer_note: AI only identified the ACL issue but missed the missing NAT translation for the DMZ host.

symptom: IPsec VPN tunnel shows as down.
ai_root_cause: IKEv1 Phase 1 fails due to encryption algorithm mismatch between peers.
human_correction: Mismatch confirmed but AI suggested fixing only the branch side. Both peers need matching policies.
reviewer_note: AI was partially correct but gave one-sided fix. Both routers need reconfiguration.

ai_root_cause: Port security violation triggered by new switch MAC address.
reviewer_note: AI correctly diagnosed port security as the cause. err-disabled confirmed in show output.

ai_root_cause: VLANs not created on SW2 causing STP to prune them from trunk.
human_correction: AI confidence was Low but diagnosis was correct. Evidence was clear from show vlan brief.
reviewer_note: AI underestimated its confidence. The show vlan brief output makes this unambiguous.

symptom: Routing table shows correct routes but traffic loops.
ai_root_cause: AI diagnosed a missing route but the actual fault is a routing loop between R1 and R2.
human_correction: The routing loop exists because R1 and R2 each point to the other for 10.0.0.0/8. The fix is removing one static route not adding one.
reviewer_note: AI misidentified the fault type entirely — it suggested adding a route when the problem was that existing routes form a loop.
